description.value:
Long hours spent examining and testing enhanced gear have sharpened your instincts. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20, and increase the number of items you can have attuned at once by 1.

You have advantage on ability checks made to identify items. Additionally, once per long rest you may spend 10 minutes handling an object to learn everything about it: its properties, whether it needs attunement, its remaining charges (if any), and any powers currently affecting it — including which power created it, if it was made that way.
